name: alterno-spatial-review
description: Open protocol, SDK, validators, adapters, and conformance tests for Alterno Spatial Review.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @alterno-dev/spatial-review-protocol && npm run build -w @alterno-dev/spatial-review && npm run build -w @alterno-dev/spatial-review-validator && npm run build -w @alterno-dev/spatial-review-cli
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run -w @alterno-dev/spatial-review-protocol && npm pack --dry-run -w @alterno-dev/spatial-review && npm pack --dry-run -w @alterno-dev/spatial-review-validator && npm pack --dry-run -w @alterno-dev/spatial-review-cli
